At hand2mind®, we believe students learn best by doing. As the leader in innovative hands-on learning since 1965, we design solutions that help students and teachers unlock deeper understanding from the first day of preschool to high school graduation and beyond. We offer over 8,000 educational and supplemental materials for math, science, reading/language arts, and STEM, including popular brands such as Hands-On Standards®, VersaTiles®, and Cuisenaire® Rods.
